summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) fetches the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (github.com/oven-sh/bun), extracts it to a temporary directory, chmod +x's the binary, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js on every npm install. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle heavily obfuscated with a rotating string array (WV8StW), a large encoded constant table, and machine-generated hex-only identifiers; it is not referenced by the package's own dist/index.js and its thematic naming is unrelated to the advertised purpose of the package (a micro-frontend dependency compatibility checker). The obfuscated payload is executed under the freshly downloaded alternate runtime at install time, giving arbitrary code execution on the installer's host with no relationship to the package's documented functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
